category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase input dropout to 0.15 and reduce Adam learning rate to 7e-4. Stronger regularization paired with smaller updates may improve generalization while retaining current capacity. Architecture, loss, readout, checkpoint shapes, routing and training limits remain unchanged; the predictor requires no changes.

response.change_summary: Jointly tune shared dropout and learning-rate defaults, preserving one GRU4Rec checkpoint per category.
